results.title: Property Tax Information | Bexar County, TX - Official Website
results.snippet: APPRAISAL DISTRICTS The Bexar Appraisal District sets your property values. In Texas, appraisal districts are responsible for identifying and appraising properties for ad valorem purposes. In Latin, ad valorem translates into "according to value." Pursuant with the Texas Property Tax Code, properties are taxed according to their fair market value.
